text:
leo: Quick relnotes thread: small release tomorrow with snippet refreshes and two tiny features: "prefix-cache v2" and "policy routing (beta)". Need 3 bullets, a homepage blurb, and a one-line known issue about transient 503s on Dedicated.
anika: I can draft bullets. Keep them end-user facing. I'll link to SDK ref for config details.
morgan: I'll update Python and Go snippets. Found a Go sample using old constructor: `NewClient(ctx)` -> `NewClientWithOpts(ctx, opts)`. Will PR.
leo: Avoid long code blocks in relnotes. Tiny inline example OK, link to guides.
tim: Running linkcheck now; staging build showed one stale anchor in /guides/cache#v1-to-v2. I'll add a redirect as part of the snippet PR if needed.
anika: Draft bullets: - Prefix cache v2: faster cold-starts and smaller memory footprint. - Policy routing (beta): prefer cost-optimized GPUs for non-critical traffic with automatic fallbacks. - Snippet updates: SDK examples refreshed for new client options. Known issue: Some Dedicated clusters may return transient 503s during GPU warmup; retrying after a short delay typically succeeds.
morgan: PRs: #1405 (py), #1406 (go). Updated content/releases/next.md with the bullets.
leo: Homepage blurb suggestion: "New: faster prefix caching (v2) and policy-based routing (beta) — see release notes." Short and punchy.
tim: After PRs land I'll re-run the site build and linkcheck. If anchor still broken I'll add a quick redirect entry.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: branch docs/relnotes-3187654321 deployed to staging; build passed with one localization warning.
leo: Great. Plan: land snippet PRs, fix redirect if necessary, merge and cut release by 10:00 PT. Thanks all.
